slides.title: Abandonment is highest at account creation
slides.note: 38% of guests leave when asked to make an account

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Five of six shoppers abandoned a checkout in the last month because it asked them to create an account. Most would have finished as a guest.

sections.heading: What we heard
quotes: "I'm not typing a card number on my phone again." (P2)
"If it wants a password, I'm gone." (P5)

sections.heading: Themes
bullets: Account creation feels like a trap
Card entry on mobile is the slowest step
Express pay builds trust when it's offered first

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.body: Move account creation after purchase, lead with express pay, and remember cards for returning guests.
